Leah Ortiz: FYI customer EchoMetrics reports Apr invoice low — their SDK shows 1,045,210 embeds but our export is 1,012,840. they called out a 2026-04-20 ingestion window.
Marco Diaz: quick check: did we roll the kafka consumer commit change last week? there was a patch that moved commits earlier for consumer group `ingest-embed` to reduce lag.
Priya Singh: if commits moved ahead of processing we might drop messages at reprocessing/backfill time. any retention gaps?
Marco Diaz: retention unchanged, but commit timing means some offsets could be skipped in crash-recovery window. server logs show consumer_commit at 2026-04-20T04:00:05Z with offset=2345678 while processing showed last_handled=2345600 — suspicious.
Leah Ortiz: customer estimate delta ~32k embeddings. at $0.0005 this is ~$16. They want immediate adjustment while we investigate.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): I approve provisional credit up to $20. Create ticket and mark provisional.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-5010 created: EchoMetrics possible kafka commit-induced undercount.
Marco Diaz: Ops will run an offset-scan for 2026-04-20 to enumerate messages between last_handled..committed and replay if present. ETA 12 hours.
Priya Singh: finance note: hold invoice 2026-04 for EchoMetrics as "under review" and show provisional credit $20 on portal.
Leah Ortiz: I'll message the customer: "We've applied a $20 provisional credit and are running a logs backfill; ETA 1 business day."
Marco Diaz: posting planned SQL/psuedocode in FIN-5010 for audit: SELECT count(*) FROM kafka_raw WHERE partition=12 AND offset > 2345600 AND offset <= 2345678 AND customer='echo_metrics';
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): label FIN-5010 "provisional-credit-applied". if backfill yields more than $100 escalate to revenue leadership.
Leah Ortiz: thanks team — will monitor FIN-5010 and update customer once backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
